input.description: 00967 unpacked image (same as l10n-utf8-949x-static.json) read through the private IDA database copy; string and xref checks also on the 949x-patched runtime copy; pack and VN client files read only
input.database_copy: local/ida/kr-opus.i64 (private copy; a second scratch copy was opened read-only and not saved)

method: IDA Pro headless (MCP) pseudocode, disassembly and xrefs on the database copy; scan of IAT call sites for CreateWindowExA, AdjustWindowRect, GetSystemMetrics, SetWindowPos; scan of all code immediates for 800/600 and 1024/768 pairs; string and catalog.csv search for resolution/screen/window terms; per-entry image dimension survey (JPEG SOF and i16 header) over every .idx/.idd pack of the KR client and of the VN client (entries over 8 MB skipped). No native run. Raw pseudocode stays under local/.

findings.verdict: confirmed (static): 00967 has a window-mode scale of 1x/1.5x/2x. It renders a fixed 800x600 frame and stretches it. It has no larger UI layout and no 1024x768 mode.
findings.option_dialog: Option dialog builder at 0xBDC280..0xBDC470 shows the window-mode checkbox (option id 15, label OptionDlgWindowMode) and a three-button group (option id 22, labels OptionDlgResolution = 창모드 배율, OptionDlgResolution_0/1/2 = 1배/1.5배/2배). Both are gated by 0xBE0C60 (flag 239) and 0xBE0BD0 (flag 323), which call stub 0x456AD0 (xor al,al; ret), so the gate is always open in this build.
findings.option_table: Table at 0x19A6820 (12-byte entries: id, name pointer, default) holds WindowedScreen id 15 default 1 and Resolution id 22 default 0, among other user options; loaded by 0x12240E0 (xref 0x12243A1), which opens HKCU SOFTWARE\MPlay\Crazy Arcade and SOFTWARE\Nexon\BubbleFighter.
findings.size_list: 0x125B580 (CMainWindow constructor) registers 800x600, 1200x900 and 1600x1200 in a vector at this+0x28 (immediates 0x320/0x258, 0x4B0/0x384, 0x640/0x4B0).
findings.apply_scale: 0x125A330 reads option 22 through 0x122A3D0, maps the index to a size with 0x125B280 and calls 0x14B8920, which dispatches vtable +264 = 0x14E1790 (IDirect3DDevice9::Reset with the new back buffer). 0x125B600 falls back to the largest list entry that fits the desktop when the current size exceeds GetSystemMetrics.
findings.render_path: 0x14DFFE0 creates an 800x600 render target (immediates at 0x14E01C0/0x14E01C5). 0x14DECD0 presents with EndScene then vtable +136 (StretchRect) from that target to the back buffer; filter point when the factor is integral, linear otherwise (flag at this+124). 0x14E2DC0 computes factor = back buffer width / 800.0f (constant at 0x1728B14) and centres the window with AdjustWindowRect and SetWindowPos.
findings.window_creation: 0x1259F60 creates the main window with CreateWindowExA from hard-coded 800x600 (immediates 0x1259FA5/0x1259FAC), class name Crazy Arcade, then AdjustWindowRect. 0x14DFF40 (vtable +0xC of the device class) sets the logical rect 0,0,800,600. 0x14E1C90 toggles fullscreen and uses 800x600 when switching to fullscreen. Back buffer width and height come from variable qword 0x1A9012C.
findings.hardcoded_layout: About 100 functions contain 800 and 600 immediates side by side (for example 0x54E700, 0x5C4270, 0x8D7ED0, 0xCD8D10, 0x105FD20, 0x1283110): UI layout is hard-coded for 800x600. 1024 immediates found elsewhere are not resolutions (0x1231BD0 pool size, 0x409141 CPU flag routine, library code at 0x157xxxx/0x158xxxx).
findings.not_found: No strings ScreenMode, ScreenSize, WideMode, BigScreen or a resolution command-line switch; no branch that selects between 800x600 and 1024x768. catalog.csv rows with Korean resolution/screen-size words are only OptionDlgResolution, OptionDlgResolution_0/1/2, OptionDlgWindowMode, OptionDlgFullScreen, ToggleWindowFailedAskToSave and Win8Support_ToggleWindowFailed (the word 해상도 matches only item-dismantling rows). CAKR.ini and cavn.ini are encrypted and were not read.
findings.pack_image_survey: KR 00967: 49,205 images measured; none is at least 900 wide and 700 high; none is 1024x768, 1200x900 or 1600x1200; 92 are exactly 800x600 (full-screen backgrounds such as FxDesktop LoginStage/CAStage, LobbySquare/CAStage, UX/CAStage_Lobby). VN 116: 20,648 images measured; none is at least 900 wide and 700 high; 61 are 800x600. Names with _1024/_Wide/_Big/HD suffix for backgrounds: none (WideBG is a lobby chat frame, 1024 in item names is an item id).
findings.vn_exe: The VN unpacked exe has no OptionDlgResolution or WindowedScreen strings, no 1024x768 immediate pair and 11 800x600 push pairs; it has a FullScreen option string only. So no evidence was found that the VN client uses a 1024x768 interface; the statement should be treated as unsupported.

verified_vs_inferred.verified_static: All VA roles above were read in the database copy; catalog rows and the image survey were read from files.
verified_vs_inferred.inferred: That the registry is where Resolution is stored (the table loader opens HKCU keys, but the value read for id 22 and its format were not traced); that scaling is uniform for the whole frame (follows from the 800x600 render target plus StretchRect).

limits: Not run natively, so the option dialog, the Reset and the stretched picture were not seen. Not checked: where the Resolution option is stored and in which format; whether mouse coordinates are divided by the scale factor at 1.5x/2x; behaviour on desktops smaller than the chosen size beyond the 0x125B600 fallback; the VN exe was scanned by bytes and strings only, without its database. Scaling a fixed 800x600 frame does not give the text more room, so it does not fix label overflow.
